Index.subtitle: Publish ecological projects. Fund real-world milestones. Track every contribution on-chain. Build a regenerative future — together.
Index.hero_subtitle: The on-chain protocol for regenerative work. Open hardware, milestone escrow, and validator attestations — no intermediaries, all proof.
Index.featured_card_desc: Open-source sensors for soil fungal network monitoring in the Cascadia bioregion.
Index.section_grow_subtitle: How {brand} grows from an idea into real-world impact.
Index.step1_desc: Creators publish hardware designs or ecological actions. The community seeds the initial funding pool.
Index.step2_desc: Capital flows into milestone-locked smart contracts. Backers get verifiable proof of impact.
Index.step3_desc: Local validators attest to the real-world outcomes. Funds are trustlessly released to creators.
Index.featured_projects_empty_subtitle: Be the first to publish a regenerative project.
Index.activity_title: Every contribution grows a visible root.
Index.activity_subtitle: No black boxes. {brand} uses public smart contracts to ensure transparency from the first dollar to the final tree planted.

NoticeModal.title: Notice To Users
NoticeModal.p1: {brand} is open-source, experimental software for coordinating on-chain ecological funding.
NoticeModal.p2: It is not an investment product or asset-management service, and it does not offer profit-sharing or guaranteed outcomes. Tokens are used to participate in protocol coordination and project funding within predefined rules.
NoticeModal.p3: Smart contracts may change or fail, and token availability/prices can fluctuate — you may lose funds. Use only if you understand these risks.
NoticeModal.p4: Nothing here is financial, investment, tax, or legal advice. By proceeding, you acknowledge you're interacting with decentralised software — not an intermediary.

ProjectDetail.actions_disabled: Actions stay disabled until on-chain sync completes.
ProjectDetail.live_overrides: Live contract reads override cached totals whenever possible.
ProjectDetail.milestone_intro: This view follows the real {contract} contract: three claimable stages, live escrow totals, and validator-gated releases instead of the four-stage mock shown in the design artboard.
ProjectDetail.pending_registration: This project has not finished on-chain registration yet. Stage status uses backend cache until `onChainId` becomes available.
ProjectDetail.stage1_desc: Backers seed the escrow. Capital accumulates while the creator prepares the first deliverable.
ProjectDetail.stage2_desc: Validators confirm the milestone and unlock the next tranche from the contract.
ProjectDetail.stage3_desc: The last claim releases the remaining balance, including any rounding remainder held by the escrow.
ProjectDetail.final_remainder: Final stage claims any remainder still held in escrow after earlier releases.
ProjectDetail.contributors_intro: Backers are grouped by wallet so repeated funding activity reads as one relationship, not noisy rows.
ProjectDetail.loading_contrib_history: Loading contributor history from the contract…
ProjectDetail.first_contrib_hint: The first verified contribution will appear here as soon as capital reaches the project.
ProjectDetail.status_pending_body: Metadata exists in the backend cache, but the contract id has not been linked yet. Funding actions stay disabled until sync completes.
ProjectDetail.status_network_body: Connect to a configured {brand} network before sending fund or withdraw transactions.
ProjectDetail.status_closed_body: The contract currently marks this project inactive, so new contributions are blocked.
ProjectDetail.status_claimed_body: The project has already reached the end of its 3-stage release flow.
ProjectDetail.status_live_body: Allowance, funding, and withdrawals will sync back into the backend cache after each confirmed write.
ProjectDetail.connect_to_fund: Connect a wallet to fund or withdraw
ProjectDetail.no_wallet_hint: The detail page still shows cached metadata without a wallet, but writes remain disabled.
ProjectDetail.fund_help: If allowance is missing, the app will request USDC approval before sending the contribution.
ProjectDetail.fund_dialog_desc: Contributions are transferred into the {contract} escrow contract for project #{id}.
ProjectDetail.approve_flow_body: The app checks allowance against the accepted token ({token}) and only asks for approval if needed.
ProjectDetail.withdraw_dialog_desc: Only the recorded creator can release the current stage from escrow.
ProjectDetail.release_guard_body: After confirmation, the client refreshes live chain state and posts the updated totals back to the backend cache.
ProjectDetail.err_connect: Connect a wallet before funding this project.
ProjectDetail.err_unavailable: Funding is unavailable until the contract route is fully configured.
ProjectDetail.err_amount: Enter a valid USDC amount greater than zero.
ProjectDetail.err_owner_only: Withdrawals are only available to the project owner when a stage is claimable.
ProjectDetail.fund_success: Contribution confirmed and synced back into the project cache.
ProjectDetail.withdraw_success: Stage withdrawal confirmed and project progress refreshed.
